metadata.title: Video and Digital Games — Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Labels — Specification

clauses.heading: SCOPE
clauses.text:
This standard specifies the age-rating labels and
content descriptors based on the content of video
games and digital games that are published and
distributed publicly.

clauses.heading: REFERENCES
clauses.text:
The standards given below contain provisions
which, through reference in this text, constitute
provision of this standard. At the time of
publication, the editions indicated were valid. All
standards are subject to revision, and parties to
agreements based on this standard are encouraged to
investigate the possibility of applying the most
recent editions of these standards:

clauses.heading: TERMS AND DEFINITIONS
clauses.text:
For the purposes of this standard, the definitions
given in IS 19226 and the following shall apply:

Age-Rating Mark — A classification assigned
to video or digital games that indicates the suitability
of the content for specific age groups based on the
presence of elements such as violence, language,
sexual content, or other mature themes.

Content Descriptor — Terms that accompany
and aid an age-rating mark under this standard in
providing specific information about the type of
content that led to the age-rating classification,
which assists consumer in making informed
decisions.

Age-Rating and Content Descriptor Label —
Display of age-rating classification and content
description categories as specified under this
standard for video or digital games.

clauses.heading: CONTENT DESCRIPTORS CATEGORIES
clauses.text:
Video or digital games published, or distributed,
shall carry the appropriate content descriptors in
lowercase letters separated by commas, which may
be self-assessed according to content within the
game as provided in Table 2, except under the
condition of limited display-size, as specified under

The age-rating and content descriptor label on
video games, or their marketing material, applicable
to games made available through physical or digital
storefronts, shall be clearly and legibly displayed to
ensure easy visibility and understanding.

The age-rating and content descriptor label
shall be displayed on the game box art, digital game
or app storefronts, television advertisement, digital
advertisements, and physical advertisements of the
relevant game.

The text, symbols, and background contrast
shall be designed to meet the appropriate legibility
requirements, enabling clear reading under normal
usage conditions.

The age-rating label shall be placed at a
prominent location on the primary display panel or
the initial viewing screen of the digital storefront for
the relevant game.

The outer boundary of the label shall be a
square bisected into two equal halves by a single
horizontal line. The dimensions of the label shall
conform to requirements mentioned in Fig. 1.
Video or digital games published, or distributed,
shall carry the appropriate Age-Rating Mark, in
uppercase letters, which may be self-assessed, as
provided in Table 1, except in cases of limited
display size, as specified under 6.2.5 where a
modified label may be applicable.

The total length of the label shall equal the total
width of the label. The length of the upper and lower
compartments of the label shall also be equal to each
other.

The text constituting the age-rating mark shall
be centrally placed in the upper compartment of the
label, whereas the text constituting the content
descriptor shall be placed within the lower
compartment in accordance with the legibility
standards.

Table 1 Age-Rating Mark Categories
(Clause 4)
Sl No.
(1)
Age-Rating Mark
(2)
Appropriate Use Case Based on In-Game Content
(3)
i)
U/A 0+
Applicable to content that is suitable for all ages, and may
contain cartoon or fantasy elements. Should not contain any
bad language or harmful visuals.
ii)
U/A 3+
Applicable to content that is suitable for ages 3 and up, and may
contain cartoon, fantasy, a very mild form of violence or mild
language (in a comical context or a childlike setting) is
acceptable. No bad language should be heard. The game should
not contain any sounds or pictures that are likely to frighten
young children.
iii)
U/A 7+
Applicable to content that is suitable for ages 7 and up. May
contain unrealistic/mild violence, and/or language to a slightly
greater degree than U/A 3+ rated content.
iv)
U/A 13+
Applicable to content that is suitable for ages 13 and up. May
contain violence, suggestive themes, crude humour, minimal
blood, or infrequent usage of strong abusive language.
v)
U/A 16+
Applicable to content that is suitable for ages 16 and up. May
contain intense violence, blood, gore, sexual content, simulated
gambling, or very strong and abusive language.
vi)
A
Applicable to content that is suitable for adults only. May
contain prolonged scenes of intense violence or graphic sexual
content.

Table 2 Content Descriptors Categories
(Clause 5)
Sl No.
(1)
Content Descriptor
(2)
Appropriate Use Case Based on In-Game Content
(3)
i)
Violence
Any depiction of brutal physical force intended to harm or kill
involving blood, including realistic and fantasy violence.
ii)
Vulgar language
Abusive, vulgar, or derogatory language that may offend and impact
the sensibilities of an ordinary viewer.
iii)
Nudity
The depiction of the human body where genitalia, buttocks, or female
breasts are exposed, in a sexual or non-sexual context. This
descriptor is applicable to either partial or full nudity.
iv)
Sexual content
Content that refers to any depiction or representation of sexual
behavior, activities, or themes.
v)
In-game purchases
This descriptor is applicable where the game offers users the option
to exchange real-world currency for access to virtual goods, services,
or benefits within the game.
vi)
Substance abuse
The portrayal or depiction of the use, consumption, or trafficking of
illegal drugs, alcohol, or tobacco, including scenes that glorify or
trivialize substance use.
vii)
Gambling
Content that promotes or glorifies betting or gambling activities.
viii)
Socially sensitive
themes
Content that significantly relates to social discrimination, race,
religious symbols, deities, caste, nationality, gender, physical and
mental disability, and which may impact the sentiments of domestic
communities.

The typeface of all text constituting elements of the
label shall be ‘Roboto’, as maintained and published

text should be adequate to ensure the legibility of all
information presented on the label.
Once applied to a game, the age-rating and content
descriptor label shall not be edited, obscured,
altered, or removed under any circumstances. The
label shall remain intact and visible for the duration
of the game's availability on any platform to ensure
consistent consumer information.
